initialize_render_module: call initialize to lazily load OpenGL, GLUT, and fairmotion visualization modules
get_flag_keyword: call get_flag with a keyword like 'shadow' to retrieve its current boolean or list value
configure_render_flags: modify the global flag dictionary to toggle rendering options like ground, collision, or overlay
customize_agent_colors: use COLORS_FOR_AGENTS list to assign distinct RGBA colors to up to 17 agents in the scene
map_keyboard_toggles: use the toggle dictionary to map keyboard keys to render flag names for interactive control
